newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Dec private construction rises 9.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Greek Dec private construction rises 9.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Greece's index of private construction activity measured by the construction volume based on the number of building permits issued rose 9.5 percent year-on-year in December, the National Statistics Service (NSS) said.
"In December construction volume based on the number of building permits nationwide reached 4.853 million cubic metres against 4.430 million in December 1995, an increase of 9.5 percent," NSS said.
In the first twelve months of the year, private construction activity was up 20.7 percent with the rise more pronounced in the Attica region, up 32.1 percent, it said.
